verdict.rationale: Viam's docs explicitly describe cloud-managed fleet monitoring, alerting, remote access/control, and a Fleet API for managing organizations, locations, and individual machines, plus a machine status/health check surface (GetMachineStatus) and OTA updates — directly matching the ops-lead fleet dashboard story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the dashboard's usability at scale, and no explicit mention of location-tracking visualization within the dashboard.
